2124588502172291173.en_summary: @menshush Check this out. $IREN and $NBIS analysis: $IREN easiest hold because only price broke (closed $11.82, down 34.95% on week, new 52-week low), $4B ARR slipped to Jan-Feb 2027 is delay not break, roughly $6B funding gap on roughly $15B FY27 capex is sizing question, power thesis intact. $NBIS hardest because story tested: revenue beat $980.8M but stock fell about 17% on $40-45B 2027 capex against $12-13B guided revenue, ARR $6.4B with $7B-plus pushed to Feb 2027; broke $109 line, closed $81.31 near 52-week low $73.52. 2124588502172291173.zh_summary: @menshush 看看這個。$IREN 和 $NBIS 分析：$IREN 是最容易持有的，因為只有價格破裂（收盤 $11.82，一週下跌 34.95%，新52週低），$4B ARR 延遲至 2027年1-2月不是破裂，約 $15B FY27 資本支出上的約 $6B 資金缺口是規模問題，電力論點完好。$NBIS 是最難的，因為故事本身受考驗：收入超預期 $980.8M 但股票因 2027 年 $40-45B 資本支出對 $12-13B 指引收入而下跌約 17%，ARR $6.4B 且 $7B+ 推至 2027年2月；跌破 $109，收盤 $81.31，接近 52週低 $73.52。BofA 下調目標至 $265 維持買入，Citi 至 $215，Zacks 至持有。長期兩者都能贏，$NBIS 是最純粹的轉換賭注，如果支出轉為合約收入，重評最大。
